figures.title: The five phases of the software development lifecycle
figures.description: Five boxes arranged in a ring, connected by arrows in order: Planning, Analysis, Design, Development, and Maintenance. A long arrow returns from Maintenance to Planning, showing that maintenance generates new requirements and the cycle repeats. Each box lists its main output: planning produces a feasibility assessment and requirements, analysis produces a model of the problem, design produces an architecture and interfaces, development produces working tested code, and maintenance produces fixes and enhancements.
